# DayEnglish SDK snapshot

The project uses @dayenglish/game-sdk 0.2.0 from dayenglish-game-sdk-0.2.0.tgz. npm ci installs this archive without requiring the neighbouring OxfordEnglish checkout.

- Contents: package.json, README.md, index.js, index.d.ts.
- SHA-256: a31d2c8a5d392e4269d5544c96d8b4d2e2a9855a8d88b42c60ca175ed0552ceb.
- Origin: the owner's OxfordEnglish/packages/game-sdk integration. No application source, account settings or secrets are included.
- The SDK package does not declare a public license; this snapshot is included for the owner's DayEnglish integration.

The superseded 0.1.0 archive is local-only and ignored. Update the current archive, package.json and package-lock.json together when adopting a new SDK version.
